title: Min Aung Hlaing Begins Two-Day Cambodia State Visit, Meeting Hun Sen and Hun Manet Amid ICC Warrant Calls
detail: Myanmar junta chief and president Min Aung Hlaing arrived in Phnom Penh on the morning of September 11, 2026, for a two-day state visit at the invitation of King Norodom Sihamoni — his fourth visit to an ASEAN member state as he seeks to restore standing within the bloc since being sworn in as president in April 2026. He is scheduled to hold a summit meeting with Senate President Hun Sen and bilateral talks with Prime Minister Hun Manet. Rights groups renewed calls for Cambodian authorities to arrest him and refer him to the International Criminal Court, which sought an arrest warrant against him in 2024 over alleged crimes against humanity targeting Rohingya Muslims in western Myanmar.

media.caption: Min Aung Hlaing departs for his two-day state visit to Cambodia, September 11, 2026.

title: Junta Airstrike Kills 63-Year-Old Woman in Kyauksaik Village, Ponnagyun Area
detail: A junta airstrike hit Kyauksaik village in the Ponnagyun/Rathedaung offensive zone of Rakhine State on September 11, 2026, killing 63-year-old Daw Hla Than Yi. The strike came amid continued SAC air and naval bombardment of the Sittwe-Ponnagyun frontline as part of 'Operation 4926,' the counteroffensive the military launched September 4 to retake ground from the Arakan Army.

title: Junta Column Retreats From Zinbon Village Near Shwegu After Heavy Losses to KIA-Led Forces
detail: A Myanmar military column from the 33rd Light Infantry Division, which had been fighting joint resistance forces led by the Kachin Independence Army near Zinbon village, Shwegu Township, since late August, retreated on September 11, 2026 after suffering significant casualties, including officers at battalion command level. The ground fighting formed part of a wider KIA-led campaign to secure the Ayeyarwady River resupply route between Katha, Shwegu and Bhamo, which has separately destroyed at least 14 junta vessels since late August.
